title: 36 Hours in Providence, R.I.
abstract: An Ivy League college, a cutting-edge art school and top-flight chefs have helped the city shed its reputation as a Boston suburb.

title: 36 Hours in Denver
abstract: As easy as this city may be to navigate -- you can practically see from one end to the other -- Denver’s political and social landscapes can still be tough for outsiders to read.

title: 36 Hours in Minneapolis-St. Paul
abstract: From independent theaters to art centers, there is a depth of cultural amenities to the twin cities that will surprise first-time visitors.

title: 36 Hours in Mykonos, Greece
abstract: Hoteliers and restaurateurs are creating magic by mixing a healthy dose of the island’s hedonistic past with a new reality of luxury accommodations and fusion gastronomy.

title: 36 Hours in Biarritz
abstract: The posh seaside town in southwest France is enjoying a renaissance, as people discover the appeal of this aristocratic resort where worlds collide and expectations are upended.
